scope: Native policy calibration, established before evaluating changed browser policy output
native_float_policy_comparison: Match the source operation order and Java float32 conversions, not a fitted falloff or volume curve
source_packet_and_gameplay_authority: No client-side invention of packet IDs, committed outcomes, server music-region selections, instance transforms, or source morph variables
native_quantization: Record original pre-device and device-quantized values separately. Source clipping is not silently relabeled an extra browser clip or removed by normalization.
